meta.description: Canada's handball supply store. Shoes, balls, apparel, protection, resin — plus the goals, nets and court lines nobody else on this continent stocks. 10% of merch sales go back into growing the sport here.

home.heroTitle: Stop paying duty on a pair of shoes.
home.heroBody: Every piece of handball equipment in this country arrives from Europe — three weeks late, in euros, with a customs bill stapled to the box. We are fixing that.
home.gapBody: European handball retailers sell shoes, balls and kit. Not one of them sells a goal, a net, or a set of beach boundary lines — the exact things a new Canadian club needs first. That is where we start.
home.newsletterBody: One email when the store goes live. Nothing else.

catalog.empty: Nothing listed here yet — this category opens as supplier agreements land.

status.notifyBody: We are still finalising supply on this one. Leave your email and you will be the first to know when it lands — no other mail, ever.
status.freightBody: Goals, frames and court packages cannot ship at parcel rates. Tell us where it is going and we will quote the crate, the carrier and the delivery window.
status.podNote: Printed on demand. Ships in 5–9 business days.

fund.title: 10% back into Canadian handball
fund.basisMerch: 10% of gross revenue from our own merch line.
fund.basisAll: 10% of gross revenue across every product we sell.
fund.whyBody: Handball in Canada does not lose players because the sport is hard to like. It loses them because a club cannot find a goal to buy, a school cannot source twelve size-2 balls, and a beach programme cannot get boundary lines shipped across the border. Money is the bottleneck at exactly the moment a programme is most fragile.
fund.howBody: Grants to clubs, schools and beach programmes for the equipment they cannot otherwise afford. Applications open once the store does.
fund.transparencyTitle: How you will know it happened
fund.transparencyBody: We publish what came in, what went out and who received it, every quarter, on this page. A donation promise you cannot audit is just marketing.

clubs.title: Kitting out a club, a school or a programme
clubs.body: Bulk orders, team kit, and full court setups are quoted directly. Tell us the roster size, the format and the deadline — we will come back with pricing and a realistic delivery date.
clubs.formSent: Sent — we will be in touch.
clubs.formError: Something went wrong. Email us directly instead.

merch.title: Merch
merch.body: Designed here, printed on demand, and the reason the Fund can exist — this is the line whose margin we control, so this is the line that pays into it.
merch.fundBadge: 10% of this line funds Canadian handball
